WITH order_seller_shipping AS (
  SELECT
    LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
    LEFT(oi.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
    MIN(CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS DATE)) AS promised_ship_date,
    CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE) AS shipping_date
  FROM order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY
    LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10),
    LEFT(oi.order_id, 10),
    CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS DATE)
),
seller_order_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    oss.seller_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oss.order_id) AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN oss.shipping_date IS NOT NULL
       AND (oss.shipping_date > oss.promised_ship_date)
      THEN oss.order_id
      ELSE NULL
    END) AS late_shipments,
    AVG(orv.review_score) AS average_review_score
  FROM order_seller_shipping AS oss
  LEFT JOIN order_reviews AS orv
    ON LEFT(orv.order_id, 10) = oss.order_id
  GROUP BY
    oss.seller_id
)
SELECT
  som.seller_id,
  COALESCE(s.seller_city, 'Unknown') AS seller_name,
  som.total_orders,
  som.late_shipments,
  (som.late_shipments * 1.0) / NULLIF(som.total_orders, 0) AS late_shipping_rate,
  som.average_review_score
FROM seller_order_metrics AS som
LEFT JOIN sellers AS s
  ON LEFT(s.seller_id, 10) = som.seller_id
GROUP BY
  som.seller_id,
  COALESCE(s.seller_city, 'Unknown'),
  som.total_orders,
  som.late_shipments,
  som.average_review_score;
